title: Inspecting and splitting strings
description: You can follow formatting, splitting and indexing through short string examples.

steps.description: You insert state and symbol into an f-string to print q0,a. The !r conversion prints quotes around the symbol in read 'a'.
split turns the two source lines into a list and separates q0,a at its comma. strip removes the surrounding spaces from '  spaced  '.

steps.question: How many times does this loop print, and which characters appear?
steps.answer: It prints twice, first a and then b. Iterating the string visits one character at a time.

steps.description: You see a and b on separate lines. The final print reports length 3, first character a and the remaining slice bc.
